rules.statement: The Supreme Court will not relieve parties of the consequences of their own folly, negligence and laches in the exercise of extraordinary powers such as revision or restitutio in integrum.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is not the function of this court in the exercise of the jurisdiction now being invoked to relieve parties of the consequences of their own folly, negligence and laches. The maxim Vigilantibus, non dormientibus, jura subvention provides a sufficient answer to the petitioner's application on the ground now under consideration."
